sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti Tarnish Gold Wheat Chain Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your everyday look with this stunning gold wheat chain bracelet, crafted for women who love effortless style. Featuring a bold braided herringbone pattern with an adjustable lobster clasp, this anti-tarnish bracelet stays shine-fresh wear after wear. A perfect gifting choice or daily staple — lightweight, durable, and forever gold.
